text:
olivia: quick sync — small pricing slate experiment for launch. scope: tighten FAQ microcopy, try two fresh tier name sets, and ship a compact cost calculator. goal: fewer billing tickets + higher trial starts.
mark: nice. what are the absolute must-fix FAQ lines?
otara: support highlights: confusion over commitments vs PAYG and how burst works with Dedicated. we should do single-sentence answers and a tiny inline glossary link.
devin: tier name ideas (new): Variant A = "Launch / Momentum / Enterprise"; Variant B = "Try / Predict / Scale". Variant A is more product-y, B leans functional. propose 50/50 test.
sophie: calculator UX: simple monthly slider + toggle [Committed | PAYG], show estimated_monthly and a helper: "Includes batching discounts and caching benefits". hide advanced inputs under "Show advanced".
olivia: routing change: if calculator committed estimate >= 7000 USD -> route to AE queue; if 1000-6999 -> SDR nurture; else marketing drip. capture utm params.
mark: analytics props: event = pricing_calc_result, include fields: commitment_mode, estimated_monthly_usd, currency, utm_campaign, tier_variant. devin: implement server-side check for enterprise routing on estimated_monthly_usd >= 7000.
otara: benchmark blurb for webinar: keep non-technical: "Lower per-unit cost at production scale". we have fresh numbers for 4k token bursts: ~33% lower cost vs Competitor Q on Dedicated config. link to appendix for details.
sophie: CTA A/B copy: "Estimate my cost" vs "Get my price". also try a variant with noun-first: "My estimated price". track trial starts per CTA.
olivia: launch post headline draft: "Pricing that helps teams ship: clearer tiers, instant estimates, and a benchmark snapshot". include 1-line on EU pricing & privacy.
devin: timeline: mock + copy by Mon EOD, slider wired by Wed, QA Thu, webinar cohort drip ready Fri. A/B test live for 14 days.
mark: UI note: when Committed selected show inline example: "Commit $X/mo -> reserved throughput Y" and a short link to how commitments are billed. seems to cut support volume.
otara: localization: add EUR and GBP toggles and a short EU privacy sentence. sophie: flag for privacy review.
launch-bot: scheduled post created for 2024-09-12 10:00 UTC in #general with benchmark snapshot and pricing link.
olivia: perfect. next check-in Tue 10am PT to confirm mocks. thanks all :raised_hands:
